[[Bandit Firestarter]]s are bandit [[elementalist]]s that roam the countryside in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]].  Their use of [[Flare]] can make them dangerous for new [[character]]s despite their low [[level]].

==Notes==
*Bandit Firestarters are the only level 1 creature in Pre-Searing to have the 100 health typical of their [[level]]. Other level 1 creatures in Pre-Searing have 80 health or less.
*Unlike [[Bandit Raider]]s they do not have natural [[health regeneration]].
